views.name: stone
views.title: The stone
views.caption: where it starts: a flat stone, and nothing on it

views.name: one
views.title: A touch
views.caption: the walls of a maze rise round where it was touched

views.name: three
views.title: Three touches, in one place
views.caption: each touch builds a level higher there, and spreads the ones below

views.name: built
views.title: A labyrinth
views.caption: nine touches: a mound of levels, each a maze, each on arches over the one below

views.name: built-turned
views.title: From another corner
views.caption: turned a quarter: it settles on a corner, looking down a diagonal

views.name: arches
views.title: Arches
views.caption: the passages below run on under the level above: its walls and walkways stand on arches

views.name: stairs
views.title: Stairs
views.caption: dead ends nothing's built over climb onto the wall at their end: the walls' tops are walkways

views.name: tower
views.title: A tower
views.caption: touched five times in the same place

views.name: print
views.title: As a print
views.caption: print: the light hatched, closer and crossed as it darkens

views.name: print-close
views.title: Close, as a print
views.caption: the arches and stairs, in lines
